author: Amr Kadry (github.com/Amrkadry)
catalog: Legacy ASP.NET Framework hardening — Dynamics/SFTP/local-idiom cases observed in real-world enterprise code reviews (2026-10-08)

categories.LH: Legacy ASP.NET Framework hardening: directory services, KDF work factors, Dynamics idioms, handler state, culture round-trips, webroot writes

tests.title: SSH host key verification disabled
tests.lookFor: GiveUpSecurityAndAcceptAnySshHostKey = true or equivalent accept-any-host-key options in SSH.NET/Renci clients
tests.expected: host key pinned or verified against a known fingerprint before any SFTP transfer

tests.title: Domain credential validation over plaintext LDAP
tests.lookFor: ValidateCredentials / PrincipalContext / DirectoryEntry binds without LDAPS or SecureSocketLayer context options
tests.expected: LDAPS (or StartTLS with certificate validation) for every directory bind; empty credentials rejected before binding

tests.title: PBKDF2 iteration count below baseline or library default
tests.lookFor: Rfc2898DeriveBytes constructed with a numeric iteration argument below 10,000, or without an iteration argument (Framework default 1,000)
tests.expected: explicit iteration count >= 100,000, or a modern KDF (Argon2/PBKDF2 via ASP.NET Identity)

tests.title: Static AES key or IV embedded as a literal
tests.lookFor: .Key / .IV assigned a string literal, a literal byte[] initializer, or Convert.FromBase64String of a constant
tests.expected: keys per-deployment from a managed store; random IV per message prepended to ciphertext

tests.title: CRM/Dynamics attribute boolean compared as case-sensitive string
tests.lookFor: entity["attr"].ToString() == "True"-style comparisons; wrapper types (OptionSetValue, Money, AliasedValue, EntityReference) stringify to their type name, silently failing the branch
tests.expected: typed accessors (GetAttributeValue<bool> / .Value) instead of stringified comparisons

tests.title: Unguarded configuration value dereference
tests.lookFor: ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["key"] immediately dereferenced (.ToString()/.Trim()/...) without a null check; the indexer returns null for a missing key
tests.expected: null-checked read, startup-time fail-fast, or a validated default defined in every deployed config

tests.title: Fail-open catch returning fixed defaults in decision paths
tests.lookFor: catch blocks whose body returns a constant (0 / 0.0 / false / null), converting internal failures into silent business decisions
tests.expected: decision and money paths fail loudly; no exception handler substitutes a business value

tests.title: Shared mutable state in globally-registered handlers/filters
tests.lookFor: instance fields (or out-argument writes like Headers.TryGetValues(name, out field)) on classes registered once at startup via Services.Replace/Filters.Add/MessageHandlers.Add
tests.expected: per-request state stays in locals or per-request storage; the component is stateless

tests.title: Culture-sensitive numeric Parse(ToString()) round-trip
tests.lookFor: (double|int|decimal).Parse over .ToString() output — a comma-decimal server locale silently changes computed amounts
tests.expected: parse the primitive directly, or pin CultureInfo.InvariantCulture on both sides

tests.title: User-supplied binary written inside the webroot with path returned
tests.lookFor: Convert.FromBase64String of caller data followed by File.WriteAllBytes under BaseDirectory/MapPath, with the absolute path returned to the caller
tests.expected: store outside the webroot or in blob storage; return an indirect reference, never the filesystem path

tests.title: Timestamp-derived filenames at second resolution
tests.lookFor: filenames built from DateTime.Now.ToString(yyyyMMddHHmmss)-style formats feeding File write APIs
tests.expected: GUIDs or a sequence with existence checks; concurrent writes must never overwrite each other

tests.title: Denylist-based input sanitization applied after encoding
tests.lookFor: Regex.Replace of a blocklist (<script, javascript:, eval(...)...) over HttpUtility.HtmlEncode'd input
tests.expected: allowlist validation at input; framework encoders at output; denylists never as the primary control

tests.title: Path.Combine with caller-influenced segment lacking containment
tests.lookFor: Path.Combine(basePath, userControlled) or File APIs on strings assembled from parameters/request values, without canonicalization + root-prefix verification
tests.expected: Path.GetFullPath then verify startswith the intended root; reject .. sequences and rooted paths

tests.title: Exception details copied into API responses
tests.lookFor: res.message = ex.Message / ex.ToString() assignments on response objects
tests.expected: generic error identifiers to callers; exception detail stays in server-side logs

tests.title: Unchecked first-element indexing on retrieval results
tests.lookFor: .Entities[0] (or ["..."][0]) indexed without an empty check after RetrieveMultiple-style calls
tests.expected: Entities.Length / FirstOrDefault guard before indexing; empty result must be a handled case

tests.title: Cleartext HTTP endpoints in code
tests.lookFor: http:// string literals used in live code (new Uri(...), BaseAddress, clients); raw public IPs upgrade severity
tests.expected: HTTPS everywhere; plain-http destinations rejected by configuration

tests.title: State-changing actions without HTTP verb constraint
tests.lookFor: controller actions named Create/Delete/Update/Save/... lacking [HttpPost]/[HttpPut]/[HttpDelete] attributes
tests.expected: every mutating endpoint pinned to its verb; CSRF surface minimized accordingly

tests.title: Long-lived OAuth access tokens without revocation
tests.lookFor: AccessTokenExpireTimeSpan >= 5 hours with no refresh/revocation provider wired
tests.expected: short access tokens + refresh flow + a revocation path that disabling an account actually triggers
